description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1.) "I'd like to know whether the Beast and the False Prophet will start burning in the lake of fire right at the 2nd advent of Jesus Christ prior to the the 2nd death and burn all the way through til the thousand years are finished, or what do the following texts imply?
Revelation 19:17-21; 20:7-10.
Secondly, the False Prophet and the Beast  whom Jesus will find at His return who will be thrown into the lake of fire, are they 2 distinct persons who will be found alive at that moment or it is something figurative?"
.
2.) "I would like to know, if we plan to have an evangelistic outreach at our local SDA church on Sabbath and as part of the outreach, we serve hot meals to those in need.
Would we break the Sabbath if:
We allow two ladies (non SDA members) whose normal Monday to Friday work consist of working in a kitchen, who volunteer to go to their place of work on Sabbath, heat up the already cooked meals, go to the outreach to dish up the meals and afterwards return to the kitchen to wash the dishes?
Are we allowed to break God's law by allowing non SDA members to do good on the Sabbath?
If so, should it be better to rather hold the same evangelistic outreach on a Sunday?"
.
3.) "In the Bible, Jesus Christ is seen in the temple at aged 12 (Luke 2 v 42) and the next time that He appeared in the Bible, was at aged of 30 (Luke 3 v 23) when He began His Ministry.
My question is where was He and what was He doing between aged 12 and age 30?
Am I missing something in the scriptures?"
.
4.) Why is it that Pastor Bohr has a different layout of the 7 heads of
Rev 17....or why is there a split within the adventist church regarding it?
.
.
